name: Reboot Hub Pre-Owned Drone Grading Standard

scope.appliesTo: Condition labels used for Reboot Hub pre-owned drone listings
doesNotRepresent: a substitute for the exact-unit listing
a flight authorization or airworthiness determination

qualifyingEvidence: No visible cosmetic marks under the defined inspection conditions
No observed crack, chip, deformation, exposed cable, binding mechanism or other material physical defect
Core functional checks completed without an unresolved warning
Exact-unit photographs support the stated condition
Only light cosmetic wear is present and visible in the exact-unit listing
No observed crack, chip, structural deformation or hidden cosmetic restoration is represented as original condition
Core functional checks completed without an unresolved warning
Original or unmodified condition is stated only when available evidence supports it

evidenceDomains.name: Identity and listing match
evidenceDomains.record: Model, configuration, internal unit identifier, exact-unit photographs and bundle contents
evidenceDomains.boundary: Sensitive identifiers remain internal or redacted

evidenceDomains.name: Cosmetic condition
evidenceDomains.record: Airframe, arms, landing surfaces, camera housing, gimbal area, fasteners, ports, controller and accessories under consistent lighting
evidenceDomains.boundary: Photographs disclose wear that could affect a reasonable buyer's decision

evidenceDomains.name: Structure and propulsion
evidenceDomains.record: Cracks, chips, deformation, looseness, impact marks, abnormal movement, propellers and visible safety concerns
evidenceDomains.boundary: A cosmetic grade cannot override a structural or flight-safety concern

evidenceDomains.name: Battery and power
evidenceDomains.record: Battery identity and accessible health, cycle, warning, swelling, terminal, charging or power-on evidence
evidenceDomains.boundary: Cycle count alone is not proof of health and batteries are disclosed separately

evidenceDomains.name: Imaging and gimbal
evidenceDomains.record: Camera output, image stability, gimbal startup and movement, lens and sensor-window condition
evidenceDomains.boundary: Calibration does not conceal binding, deformation, abnormal noise or warnings

evidenceDomains.name: Control, communication, sensors and software
evidenceDomains.record: Controller pairing, startup behavior, exact app or sensor warnings, firmware state and account-binding observations
evidenceDomains.boundary: Available checks vary by model, controller, app, firmware and region

decisionRules: Safety and function take precedence over appearance
Unknown is not the same as passed
Warranty and service eligibility remain separate
limitations: A non-invasive inspection cannot prove the absence of every latent or intermittent fault
A clean exterior cannot prove a unit has never been opened, exposed to liquid, overheated, crashed or repaired when records are unavailable
Battery cycle count, voltage or app status alone does not guarantee future battery performance
Firmware, app menus, service eligibility, account binding and regional compatibility can change after publication
The grade applies only to the recorded assessment state and exact bundle described in the listing
independenceStatement: Reboot Hub is an independent repair and resale business. It is not affiliated with, authorized by, endorsed by or sponsored by DJI.
citation: Reboot Hub. Reboot Hub Pre-Owned Drone Grading Standard. Version 1.0, reviewed July 2026. https://reboot-hub.com/pages/drone-grading-standard
